contract.structural_score_basis: Canonical Ethereum wstETH holds at 8.0. The wrapper itself is immutable direct-deployed code with a fixed stETH() dependency and no local upgrade, pause, freeze, confiscation, arbitrary-mint, parameter-setter or rescue control. The risk sits upstream: Lido governance has full reach over the mutable Accounting, StakingRouter, AccountingOracle and WithdrawalQueue stack. The ordinary route has a measured five-day Aragon vote plus a three-day Dual Governance minimum. A separately observed one-day after-schedule parameter is not added to that total because the completed walk did not establish that it extends the ordinary end-to-end floor; the supported statement is a measured eight-day ordinary minimum, not a complete global delay bound. Two zero-delay paths are narrower: 5-of-9 Accounting HashConsensus can approve reports only within frame, hash, version and protocol sanity checks, while the 3-of-6 CircuitBreaker Committee can pause new withdrawal requests and finalization for the configured 21-day period but cannot change code or seize balances, and finalized claims remain claimable. Conditional emergency execution remains unresolved. The score is not cut because no immediate full-reach bypass was established; it is not raised because the upstream stack remains upgradeable and the conditional emergency floor is not fully resolved.
contract.wrapper_basis: Canonical wstETH is direct deployed code with a fixed stETH() dependency. Its EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots are zero, and no wrapper-local privileged control was found.
contract.after_schedule_delay_treatment: Observed separately but not added to the measured ordinary minimum because the completed authority walk did not establish additive end-to-end sequencing.
contract.ordinary_governance_reach: Full reach over upgradeable Accounting, StakingRouter, AccountingOracle and WithdrawalQueue behavior through the DAO Agent.

accounting_oracle.reach_bound: Reports must match the active frame, hash and version and pass AccountingOracle, StakingRouter, withdrawal-queue and OracleReportSanityChecker validation.

withdrawal_queue_circuit_breaker.reach_bound: Can immediately pause new withdrawal requests and finalization for 21 days; cannot change code or seize balances, and already-finalized claims remain claimable.

contract.conditional_emergency_execution_basis: The complete emergency-state predicates, committee threshold and conditional bypass/global delay floor were not reduced to a single enforceable bound. No active or zero-delay bypass is inferred.
